title: Write page metadata for the active page
goal: distinguishes between tab title, page summary and text title.
summary: The introductory page for the Campus Open House requires an abstract that can be read by search tools. Describe the page using metadata in the head.
tasks: Add the meta with name="description" in the head, and write "Check the date, location and visit schedule of the campus open day" in the content.
retains the existing tab title and text title.

example.code:
<title>Community Cultural Center | Event Arrangement</title>
<meta name="description" content="Check this month’s exhibitions and workshops">
example.note: title names the page, and the content of meta stores the summary. Abstracts are usually not included in the text.

hint: meta is an empty element, and the name and content attributes are written directly on the start tag.
